preconditions: Two visible party members; the scenario centers the camera and verifies the target picker.
Check Unusable trigger resource in string1, then six ordinary UI shots using one arrow, bolt or stone, with and without a second matching pile.

Require the first pile to be deleted and selection to become fists without spare ammunition, or the second pile with one round remaining. Damage is not required: a missed shot must also consume ammunition.
Restore equipment between cases and restore save/config files afterward; no saving or original/reconstruction equivalence claim.
